title: Wallpaper Calculator
description: Calculate how many wallpaper rolls you need for any wall from its size and the roll coverage.
howto: Enter the total wall length and the ceiling height.
Enter your roll coverage (a US double roll covers about 56 sq ft).
Read the rolls to buy, rounded up.

faqs.q: What is the coverage of one roll?
faqs.a: A standard US double roll is about 20.5 in × 33 ft, covering roughly 56 sq ft. European rolls are usually 10.05 m × 0.53 m (about 57 sq ft). Check your roll label.

faqs.q: Does pattern repeat change the count?
faqs.a: Yes. Large repeats waste paper because each strip must start at the same point in the pattern. Add 1 extra roll for repeats over 12 inches.

faqs.q: Should I subtract doors and windows?
faqs.a: For small openings, no — the leftover strips are useful for above and below them. For large openings, subtract the area.
